name: smwmusic-pok-mon-nightmare-invasion-park-invasion-mid
title: Pokémon Nightmare: Invasion - Park (Invasion).mid
description:
A twisted and darkened park theme. While it keeps its quiet flavour, it comes off as nasty and altered. Can be used in a dark grassland or during cutscenes; or even in a bad ending's credits roll.

And yes, it's the park song from Pokemon Gold/Silver/Crystal.
